notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
You have at least two creature cards in your graveyard.
You have max speed.
description:
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B}, targeting two creature cards in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Slick Imitator by paying {1} and sacrificing it.
When Slick Imitator dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Slick Imitator ability, copying Victimize, with the copy targeting Slick Imitator and another creature card in your graveyard.
Resolve the copy of Victimize, causing you to sacrifice a creature and return Slick Imitator and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature sacrificed in step 5 dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.
